title: Where You Inject Matters: The Trust Region Effect in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.38867v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly adopted in long-horizon tasks and interact with diverse external environments. Despite their growing capabilities, these agents remain vulnerable to real-world attacks such as indirect prompt injections, which manipulate agents through malicious instructions embedded in external environments. While existing risk assessment work has primarily focused on the injection content, the effect of where an injection appears has not been systematically characterized. Studying injection placement requires agents to operate over longer-horizon tasks and interact with diverse environmental surfaces. Thus, we build three agentic testbeds spanning tool use, coding, and daily workflow domains with diverse injection surfaces. Holding the injection content fixed, we find that agent susceptibility varies across injection placements. We refer to this phenomenon as the trust region effect: agents implicitly assign different levels

translated_title: 注入位置很重要：LLM智能体中的信任区域效应
translated_abstract: LLM智能体在长程任务中的应用日益广泛，并与多样化的外部环境进行交互。尽管其能力不断增强，这些智能体仍然容易受到间接提示注入等现实世界攻击的影响——这类攻击通过嵌入在外部环境中的恶意指令来操纵智能体。现有的风险评估工作主要关注注入内容，而注入出现位置所带来的影响尚未得到系统性刻画。研究注入位置需要智能体在更长程的任务上运行，并与多样化的环境表面进行交互。为此，我们构建了三个覆盖工具使用、编程和日常工作流领域的智能体测试平台，涵盖多样化的注入表面。在保持注入内容不变的情况下，我们发现智能体的易受攻击程度会因注入位置的不同而变化。我们将这一现象称为“信任区域效应”：智能体会对不同区域隐式地赋予不同级别的信任。
tldr: 该论文发现了LLM智能体中的“信任区域效应”——在注入内容固定的条件下，智能体对间接提示注入的易受攻击程度会因注入在环境中的位置不同而显著变化，表明智能体会对不同区域隐式赋予不同的信任级别。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the "trust region effect" in LLM agents: holding the injection content fixed, agents' susceptibility to indirect prompt injections varies systematically depending on where the injection appears, showing that agents implicitly assign different levels of trust to different regions.
